description: Use this skill for tax year 2026 working papers in Sao Tome and Principe (STP, jurisdiction ST). It covers IVA at 15%, the half-base rule for listed food, the Db 1,000,000 exemption regime, the special small-trader payments, monthly returns, reverse charge on services from non-residents, input deduction, and the 2026 Budget VAT and stamp duty measures. It says plainly which figures come from official texts and which remain unverified because the Finance Ministry site could not be opened. Trigger phrases: Sao Tome tax, STP tax, Direccao dos Impostos, dobras, Sao Tome e Principe imposto. It is general reference for working papers, not for filing without review by a qualified professional in the country.
